subject: Vendor remit setup & PO onboarding — Epsilon Health / Redwood
messages:
From: Sally Harper <sally.harper@epsilonhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@epsilonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendor remit & PO onboarding — Redwood

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. We need to start vendor setup for Redwood so our AP team can issue POs and pay on time. Attaching our AP onboarding template to collect the required fields. Quick list of what we’ll need from you:

- Legal company name and registered VAT number (for EU entities)
- Company address and remit-to bank details (IBAN for EU) — please indicate if you require an encrypted portal for sending bank proofs
- Your preferred invoice format (PDF + line-item PO reference required)
- Do you accept self-billing or do you require buyer-issued PO only? Our system expects a PO number on every invoice (format usually EPI-XXXXX)
- Copy of tax classification (VAT registration certificate or W-8/W-9 if applicable)

Can you return the completed template and the bank proof document? Also, our AP team prefers SFTP for high-volume partners — see attachment for SFTP onboarding.

Appreciate a reply by end of next week so we can include you in the September PO cycle.

Thanks,
Sally Harper
Senior AP Manager — Epsilon Health
ap@epsilonhealth.com

Attachment: Epsilon_AP_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sally Harper <sally.harper@epsilonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor remit & PO onboarding — Redwood

Hi Sally,

Thanks — we’ll get this over. Attaching a short vendor kit and a bank proof PDF for your AP. Quick answers to your bullets to speed the process:

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- VAT: Redwood EU VAT registration is pending for the Ireland entity; for the US entity we’ll provide W-9 if needed.
- Remit: We can provide IBAN + SWIFT. We prefer to upload bank proofs to an encrypted portal; if Epsilon requires email delivery we can provide a password-protected PDF.
- Invoice format: PDF invoices with line-item PO reference and net / VAT lines are fine.
- Self-billing: We prefer buyer-issued PO on the invoice for straightforward reconciliation, but can evaluate a self-bill workflow if required.

Questions for AP: Does Epsilon require VAT split on the invoice lines (reverse-charge) or should we show gross with a zero-rated VAT line? Also, confirm PO prefix — if it’s EPI- we’ll include that in all test invoices.

We’ll return the completed onboarding template and a sample invoice.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Short_Kit.pdf (1 page), Redwood_Bank_Proof.pdf (bank statement excerpt)
From: Sally Harper <sally.harper@epsilonhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@epsilonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 07:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor remit & PO onboarding — Redwood

On Thu, Aug 14, 2025 at 10:08 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — we’ll get this over.

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks for the prompt reply. A few clarifications from AP:

- PO format: yes, our system will generate EPI-##### POs. Please ensure the invoice line includes that exact PO string.
- VAT treatment: for services where reverse-charge applies we expect vendors to include a VAT line with 0.00 and reference ‘reverse charge – art. 196’. If Redwood is not registered by payment date, AP may withhold VAT pending documentation.
- Bank data: SFTP is preferred for file exchange, but bank proofs can be uploaded through our vendor portal as an alternative. For SFTP, use the test endpoint below and put test invoices into /incoming.

SFTP test endpoint: sftp.epsilonhealth.com — see attached Epsilon_SFTP_Test_Instructions.pdf for username format and expected file layout.

We also require a signed vendor attestation for tax classification — we will send a DocuSign envelope (link included later).

Please confirm whether you want us to generate a test PO so you can submit a test invoice to the SFTP.

Best,
Sally

Attachment: Epsilon_SFTP_Test_Instructions.pdf (PDF)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sally Harper <sally.harper@epsilonhealth.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor remit & PO onboarding — Redwood

Hi Sally — appreciate the details. Proposed mutual action plan below so we have concrete dates: 

1) Aug 20 — Redwood returns completed Epsilon_AP_Onboarding_Template + encrypted bank proof (we’ll upload password-protected PDF)
2) Aug 21 — Epsilon provides test PO (EPI-10021) and SFTP test credentials
3) Aug 22 — Redwood submits a test invoice to sftp.epsilonhealth.com/incoming referencing EPI-10021 (sample attached)
4) Aug 25 — AP confirms invoice acceptance and final remittance path; DocuSign vendor attestation to be completed by Aug 25

Notes / asks:
- Attached sample invoice uses a separate tax line labeled ‘Reverse charge — art. 196’ and shows net amount + 0.00 VAT for EU remittances. Please confirm that line format will pass your validation rules.
- For bank verification we will provide a bank letter and an IBAN; happy to follow your portal flow if that’s preferred.
- HubSpot deal for tracking: https://hubspot.com/deal/4321 (internal reference).

If that timeline works, I’ll mark tasks and loop Finance for the final sign-off on Aug 25.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_sample_invoice.pdf (PDF)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sally Harper <sally.harper@epsilonhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 21:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Vendor remit & PO onboarding — Redwood (finalize plan)

Sally / Laura / Vivek — quick summary to confirm next steps and owners: 

- Soojin: upload completed Epsilon_AP_Onboarding_Template and encrypted bank proof by Aug 20 (done).
- Epsilon AP (Sally): send test PO and SFTP credentials by Aug 21.
- Laura: submit test invoice to /incoming and confirm acceptance by Aug 25.
- Vivek: follow up on DocuSign vendor attestation and tax docs; will provide W-9 or VAT certs depending on entity.

If Epsilon can generate the EPI-10021 test PO tomorrow we’ll run the sample through SFTP and report back on any validation errors. Thanks for the rapid coordination — goal is to be in the September PO cycle with normal payment terms.

Soojin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
